Maya (oncall): Heads-up: control plane in eu-central (cluster-ctrl-ec1) is rejecting config updates. Seeing 503s on controlplane-api and authz fetch failures. GPU provisioner jobs are stuck in Pending for ~6m, customers seeing model load failures. (04:12 UTC)
infra-bot: Alert: controlplane-api eu-central degraded - 503 spike. Incident INC-2026-412 created.
Jon S: Oncall +1. Is this a routing/controlplane split? Can we shift inference traffic to na-west2/dedicated while we investigate? @Sandeep Patel can you check KV/etcd replication and leader stability?
Sandeep Patel: Looking at etcd logs now — leader election churning, raft latency spikes, kv write p99 ~2.6s. Provisioner watchers are timing out, which explains pods stuck Pending. Recommend short traffic shift to na-west2 and scale provisioner replicas to 3 as a hotfix. I'll run commands if Maya approves.
Maya (oncall): Approve. Running traffic shift then scaling.
Maya (oncall): ```
# shifting live traffic off eu-central
redwoodctl traffic shift --from-region eu-central --to-region na-west2 --policy immediate --reason "controlplane kv lag"
# scale provisioner to reduce watcher timeouts
kubectl -n infra scale deploy/gpu-provisioner --replicas=3
```
deploy-bot: Command accepted: traffic shift started. change_id=cs-20260318-01. Estimated completion ~90s.
Helena: Noted that shifting will spike egress + burst GPU costs in na-west2 — we'll hit burst pricing tiers. Are we OK with short cost hit? :eyes: 
Jon S: We accept the cost for availability. Prioritize user-facing stability. Tag all billing events with INC-2026-412 and route to finance later.
Maya (oncall): Traffic shift finished, error rate returned to baseline, model loads succeeding. Provisioner replicas are up and watchers reconnected. Control plane still showing occasional config apply failures, holding fallback routing until stable.
Sandeep Patel: etcd leader stabilized after restarting cp-ctrl-agent on cp-ec1-04; kv latencies normalizing. Found OS-level i/o stall patterns on that node — currently running disk health checks and planning replacement.
Maya (oncall): Plan: keep traffic routed to na-west2 for 2 hours, then canary route small % back and monitor for config apply errors. Will capture commands and cost delta in the incident ticket. :white_check_mark: 
infra-bot: INC-2026-412 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem assigned to Maya (oncall) + Sandeep Patel.
